Michael —

Thanks for the note. We can support the Feb 4 window you proposed. Below is the minimal deliverable checklist and the activation play we expect to follow. I copied our on-call operator (Priya) and the airgap lead (Priyom) so they can confirm keys and timing.

Deliverables (what we'll send ahead of the window):
- redwood_manifest_v1.2.tar.gz (tar of manifests + SHA256 checksums)
- redwood_manifest_v1.2.tar.gz.sig (detached signature, Ed25519, signed by Redwood offline signing key)
- operator_certificate_priya.pem (X.509, operator identity, thumbprint included in manifest)
- acceptance_form_acme_filled.pdf (template signed by operator + customer ops)
- courier_seal_photos.zip (photos of sealed media & tracking stub)

Signing/verification notes:
- We use a dual-sign model for air-gapped releases: Redwood offline signing key + on-site operator key. The detached .sig signs the tarball manifest (not the binary image). Please verify the SHA256 in the manifest against the image on the media before activation.
- We'll provide the public key fingerprint in the manifest header and the operator certificate to validate the operator signature chain.

Activation play (high level):
1) You confirm the arrival and seal (ops-support to confirm).
2) On-site operator (Priya N.) provides operator_certificate_priya.pem and signs the acceptance form.
3) Remote witness/vetting via Zoom + screen share for checksum verification.
4) Operator runs activation script; Redwood will be on standby for telemetry and rollback instructions.

Requested contacts: Priya Natarajan (on-site operator) — priya_natarajan@redwood.ai (cc'd)

We will push the signed manifest to the SharePoint folder and attach to this thread once the file has been generated. Priyom — can you confirm the offline signer availability and when you can create the detached signature?

-David

--
David Kim
